cap: Every primary cause of thyrotoxicosis suppresses TSH, so the next question is whether the gland is making hormone. High uptake means synthesis, and the scan pattern names the cause; low uptake means a leak from damaged follicles or hormone from outside, which serum thyroglobulin and a pelvic scan then separate.
teach: Destructive thyroiditis is treated with a beta-blocker plus an NSAID or glucocorticoids, never a thionamide, because nothing new is being made. Subacute granulomatous thyroiditis shows granulomas with multinucleated giant cells. Iodine given to an iodine-deficient nodular goiter triggers the Jod-Basedow phenomenon, and the iodine load itself dilutes the tracer.
